nativeRoute: Figma authorized host MCP/session + Crowdin native token independently

loginFlow.steps: 复用宿主已授权 Figma MCP 会话、正确 file/node；缺失走实际宿主 Figma OAuth/连接授权。Crowdin glossary 读取使用安全注入 CROWDIN_TOKEN，缺失用户在 Crowdin API Personal Access Tokens 申请只读所需 scope。
loginFlow.authorization: Login, token creation/rotation/revocation and business writes require the current task scope; this discovery performs none.

tokenMechanism: Figma MCP/OAuth token 不等于 REST PAT；Crowdin Bearer 单独配置。禁止按照旧 SKILL 将 token 内联在命令行。
subjectPermission: Figma target file/node 读取和编辑权限；Crowdin target glossary terms 读取权限；两系统 identity/scope 分别核验。
expiryRevoke: Figma Connected apps/PAT 页面按实际选择撤销；Crowdin API Token 页面 revoke/expiry；宿主 MCP 会话状态需宿主探针，不能虚构 CLI。

versionPolicy.rule: Candidate source and published contracts do not establish deployed compatibility. Verify the target instance version and read-only supported capabilities before enabling an adapter.

verification.scope: Read-only documentation/repository discovery; no login, token issuance, credential inspection or business API execution.

referenceBase: owner-skill-root for SKILL.md/contractEntrypoints/referenceSources paths; contract field resolves from this JSON directory; upstream repository entrypoints stay repository-relative
